UPDATE backfill_progress
         SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL
         WHERE season = $1
           AND status IN ('done', 'skipped')
           AND game_id IN (
               SELECT g.game_id
               FROM games g
               WHERE g.season = $1
                 AND g.game_state NOT IN ('FUT', 'PRE')
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.game_id = g.game_id)
           )
